D: A family of undercover superheroes comes out of hiding to save the world.
P: Serve the mains at the chaotic family dinner.
S: Puffed corn snacks tossed in melted butter and smoked paprika, baked at 160C for 5 minutes so they look singed.
Grapes picked off the stem, rolled in lime juice and caster sugar, spread on a tray and frozen solid for at least 3 hours.
Prawns butterflied, dredged in flour, egg and panko mixed with coconut, fried at 180C for 2 minutes, mango and chilli dip.
M: the dinner that turns into a fight
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg, onion and Worcestershire, glazed with tomato sauce, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash and peas.
the fancy villain dinner Bob gets with Mirage
Eye fillet seared and rested, red wine jus, potato gratin (thin potato baked in cream and garlic at 160C for 75 minutes) and green beans.
W: Dark chocolate torte (chocolate, butter, eggs, sugar, almond meal) baked at 160C for 35 minutes, glazed with ganache, perfectly plain.
K: ice cold, super suit or not
Lemon juice and sugar syrup blended with ice into a slush.

s.how: Pick 500g grapes off the stem, wash and pat dry. Roll in the juice of a lime, then in 50g caster sugar. Spread on a lined tray and freeze for at least 3 hours. Serve straight from the freezer in a chilled bowl.

Butterfly 500g peeled green prawns, dip in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 60g panko mixed with 60g shredded coconut. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Blitz a mango with a little chilli and lime for the dip.

m.note: the dinner that turns into a fight
m.how: Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk, then mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and a splash of Worcestershire. Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with tomato sauce and bake at 180C for an hour. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed and 300g peas.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, fold in the chocolate and 100g almond meal. Bake at 160C for 35 minutes and cool. Pour over 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream. No decoration, no capes.

d.note: ice cold, super suit or not
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend with the juice of 5 lemons, 300ml cold water and 4 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into four glasses and serve with spoon straws.
